image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a poppy seed bagel resting on white paper. The bagel is partially visible, showing the top curve and a portion of the inner ring. It has a golden-brown crust heavily topped with black poppy seeds. The background is blurred, showing a brown leather-like surface (likely a chair or booth) and a dark grey wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the curved upper section of a ring and the inner edge defining the central hole. The proportion of the visible arc to the hole suggests a standard bagel geometry.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Golden-brown to deep amber coloration on surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Chewy texture characteristic of boiled-then-baked dough.

The object conforms to the standard visual definition of a bagel.

artifact_observations.location: Poppy seeds on the upper right curve

The background blur is consistent with a shallow depth of field photography style, not an AI generation artifact. It aids in focusing attention on the subject.
